rows.name: Contextual sidebar that changes with the active tool
Cursors and cursor fidelity per tool
Feature parity audit against CapCut / Premiere / After Effects / Photoshop / Krita / DaVinci

rows.name: Fill and recolor inside a selection on images and video
rows.evidence: apply-recolor-btn + recolor swatches; towel workflow W1-W4

rows.name: Gripped group delete / drag / shorten on the timeline
rows.evidence: removeSelectedClips / moveSelectedClips / trimSelectedClips; uniform deltas proven

rows.name: Guided-rectangle background removal (draw box, click remove, get layered mask)
rows.evidence: src/lib/guidedMatting.ts + runGuidedRectBackgroundRemoval; box_fill_ratio 0.505 proves it is not a crop

rows.name: LumaCut multi-signal masking and tracking subsystem
rows.evidence: src/lib/trackingEngine.ts (Sobel + NCC + forward/backward) + drawingEngine mask modes

rows.name: Non-destructive background removal producing a mask layer
OmniFrame object move with clean background infill
Selection invert, grow, shrink, feather
rows.evidence: subtool-invert/grow/shrink + feather, proven by towel workflow W4

rows.name: 6-Pixel Deadzone Drag State Machine
rows.evidence: real threshold state machine, but 5px not 6px (Timeline startClipDrag)

rows.name: BiRefNet High-Resolution Boundary Refinement
rows.evidence: bgRemovalEngine 'birefnet-general' = centre-weight + contrast threshold, ~10 lines. No bilateral reference network, no weights, no inference.

rows.name: Camera View Projection Surface Paint
rows.evidence: 3D painting UI present; no camera-projection surface paint solver

rows.name: Continuous Video Texture Streaming
rows.evidence: THREE.VideoTexture driven by the preview media element

rows.name: Cross-Track Group Instance Aggregation
rows.evidence: groups[] with memberIds across tracks in store

rows.name: Hardware WebCodecs Acceleration
rows.evidence: the string appears as a MediaPanel label; decoding uses HTMLVideoElement, no WebCodecs API call

rows.name: Invariant I-10 Decoupled Media Ingestion
rows.evidence: MediaPanel import decoupled from timeline insertion

rows.name: MODNet Real-Time Portrait Matting
rows.evidence: 'modnet-photographic' = skin-tone + centre-weight heuristic. No tripartite network, no inference.

rows.name: Make Unique Deep Asset Branching
rows.evidence: no make-unique / deep asset branching implementation found

rows.name: Motion Vector Kalman Filtering
rows.evidence: no kalman filter anywhere in src/

rows.name: Multi-scale Gaussian Image Pyramids
rows.evidence: guidedMatting works at a single downscaled scale; no pyramid

rows.name: Normalized Cross-Correlation Patch Matching
rows.evidence: src/lib/trackingEngine.ts matchPatch — zero-mean NCC over RGB/luma

rows.name: PTS / DTS Presentation Clock
rows.evidence: no presentation timestamp queue; playback is media-element driven

rows.name: Phase-Inverted Cancellation Matrix
rows.evidence: mid/side processing exists, no phase-inversion cancellation matrix

rows.name: Policy-Based LinkSet Synchronization
rows.evidence: linkSets + rules in store, LinkPanel UI

rows.name: Preserve Apparent World Transform on Reparent
rows.evidence: parenting exists; reparent world-transform preservation is not verified

rows.name: Real-Time Clone Stamp Sampling
rows.evidence: clone tool with cloneSourcePoint in store/overlay

rows.name: Safe Keyboard Shortcut Collision Avoidance
rows.evidence: shortcut registry exists, no collision-avoidance solver

rows.name: Seamless Audio Gapless Loop Splicing
rows.evidence: per-track gapless flag, DEVELOPMENT_LOG gapless ripple slice

rows.name: Shared Data-Block Texture Architecture
rows.evidence: three.js materials shared, but no data-block instancing bookkeeping

rows.name: SlimSAM Interactive Segment Anything
rows.evidence: 'slimsam-fast' = centreWeight > 0.35. No prompt encoder, no SAM variant.

rows.name: Sobel Edge Tensor Extraction
rows.evidence: src/lib/trackingEngine.ts computeFrameMaps builds real Sobel gradient/direction maps

rows.name: Sub-Millisecond Playhead Scrub Responsiveness
rows.evidence: scrub is responsive but no measured sub-ms budget; no evidence of the specified pipeline

rows.name: Temporal Alpha History Smoothing
rows.evidence: temporalSmoothing toggle exists in BackgroundRemovalModal; smoothing is per-request, not a persistent alpha history

rows.name: Three-Point Lighting Rig Simulation
rows.evidence: ThreeViewer ambient + key + rim directional lights

rows.name: Vector Stroke to Raster Mask Conversion
WebGPU Compute Shader Tensor Execution
rows.evidence: detectBackend() reports a 'webgpu' string; the matting path is scalar CPU JS. No WGSL, no tensor kernels.

rows.name: World-to-Local Transform Propagation
rows.evidence: transform propagation exists for OmniFrame objects; no generic world/local matrix chain
